mapper.select:
WITH buckets AS ( SELECT gs::date AS period_start, LEAST(
gs + interval '7 days'
gs + interval '1 month'
, cast(#{to} as date) + interval '1 day' ) AS period_end_exclusive FROM generate_series( cast(#{from} as date), cast(#{to} as date),
interval '7 days' interval '1 month'
) gs ), eligible AS ( SELECT s.started_at, s.ended_at, r.avg_viewers, r.total_chat FROM broadcast_sessions s JOIN reports r ON r.session_id = s.id WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND s.status = 'ENDED' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') AND s.ended_at > cast(#{from} as date)::timestamptz AND s.started_at < (cast(#{to} as date) + 1)::timestamptz ), overlaps AS ( SELECT b.period_start, b.period_end_exclusive, e.started_at, e.avg_viewers, e.total_chat, GREATEST( extract(epoch FROM LEAST(e.ended_at, b.period_end_exclusive) - GREATEST(e.started_at, b.period_start::timestamptz) ), 0 ) AS overlap_seconds FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN eligible e ON e.started_at < b.period_end_exclusive AND e.ended_at > b.period_start::timestamptz ) SELECT period_start, (period_end_exclusive::date - 1) AS period_end, round( sum(avg_viewers * overlap_seconds) FILTER (WHERE avg_viewers IS NOT NULL) / nullif( sum(overlap_seconds) FILTER (WHERE avg_viewers IS NOT NULL), 0 ) )::int AS average_viewers, coalesce(sum(total_chat) FILTER ( WHERE started_at >= period_start::timestamptz AND started_at < period_end_exclusive ), 0)::bigint AS total_chat, round(coalesce(sum(overlap_seconds), 0) / 60.0)::bigint AS broadcast_minutes FROM overlaps GROUP BY period_start, period_end_exclusive ORDER BY period_start
